condition.aelnar.text: A21 only; requires elven_rekindling, a capital in colonial_noruin, peace, is_free_or_tributary_trigger and no existing Z43; normal_or_historical_nations and was_never_end_game_tag_trigger also apply.

condition.form_one_xia.text: The potential qualification for form_one_xia is wulin with a subject using xiaken, or indep_xiaken. Territorial, peace, free-or-specified-subject and existence restrictions also apply. This is not a predecessor Tag whitelist.

condition.rosande.text: Requires adventurer_reform, found_our_nation, administrative technology of at least 7, peace, a non-custom country and a Tag other than B02. Human-controlled B04 additionally needs an owned province in blademarch_area, humacvord_area or themin_area.

condition.taychend.text: Requires reformed Taychendi religion; normally at least 900 development in taychend_superregion, or 700 with lower_taychend_dev_by_200_flag; stability of at least 1, peace and is_free_or_tributary_trigger. J84 existence, the formation flag and was_never_end_game_tag_trigger also restrict eligibility.

condition.united_one_xia.text: united_one_xia is a separate formation mechanism for wulin, with ownership of province 4559, peace and other restrictions. Its nested NOT condition within all_known_country remains unresolved here and is not rewritten as an inferred Boolean formula.

entry.Y28.text: Y28 is a documented Y99 entry example with the opening reform wulin. Its full eligibility path is not traced here; this does not establish immediate formation at campaign start or an exhaustive predecessor list.

inheritance.A21.text: Forming Z43 switches non-generic missions; the A21 prelude groups apply only to A21. No claim is made about deletion of completed mission records.

inheritance.B04.text: The branch converting B04 to Z35 switches non-generic missions; this does not establish how completed mission records are handled.

inheritance.G64.text: G64-specific mission groups apply to G64 and remain applicable to J84 when it was previously G64; this does not extend them to J84 formed by other predecessors.
